summary: Configured node1 for opsadmin SSH access using the specified ED25519 key and enforced public-key-only authentication. Verified the configuration before and after a successful node restart.
actions_performed: Generated missing SSH server host keys.
Created opsadmin with a locked password and Bash login shell.
Installed the specified public key with secure ownership and permissions.
Configured sshd to allow public-key authentication only.
Validated sshd, its port 22 listener, and a live rejection of non-key authentication.
Restarted node1 and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: opsadmin has the specified SSH public key with secure permissions
evidence.summary: Shows the opsadmin account, locked password, exact authorized key, ED25519 fingerprint, and 700/600 SSH directory and file modes.

Effective sshd policy shows public-key authentication enabled, password and keyboard-interactive authentication disabled, and AuthenticationMethods set to publickey. Live probes were refused with only publickey offered.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 92ec88af-041e-4dc3-b2b9-800263b2b2cb; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 8955a42f-ec8a-4984-9e14-a61a019e03cd; the account, exact key, key-only policy, active SSH service/socket, and port 22 listeners recovered.
